instruction: Change my amazon review about the beige sweater I ordered last calendar month. Make it 2 star with the title "Pills and Looks Worn Out Quickly.".
notes: Single-app (amazon) task. The agent must discover the review id through a lookup chain: list orders -> pick the order placed last calendar month (April 2023) -> open it to get the beige sweater product id -> confirm product details -> list the product's reviews filtered by the supervisor's email -> update that review with rating 2 and the new title. Static init facts (ordered-last-calendar-month, order-contains, review-of) encode the entity relationships the agent resolves at runtime; known-id facts model discovered identifiers. Only the review update changes the database (matching the ground truth: exactly one ProductReview updated). supervisor-complete-task carries the updated review/rating/title as non-API task-record parameters so its precondition equals the goal and it is forced to be the last action; no answer is passed since the task is not a question.
